title: Exposure Governor and Hypothesis Scheduler for Safe Model Experiments
creator: Lena Patel
description: Build a standardized A/B testing control plane called the Exposure Governor + Hypothesis Scheduler to run small-to-large model experiments safely. Goals: (1) enable safe incremental exposure (shadow -> canary -> ramp), (2) enforce multi-metric statistical checks (sequential testing, false-discovery control), (3) support auto-rollback and manual aborts, (4) surface clear signals in Console for PMs/SEs. This ticket scopes the product design, operator APIs, and success criteria for the first internal beta. It intentionally focuses on the control logic and safety heuristics, not on low-level kernel/runtime optimizations (which are tracked in ENG).
acceptance_criteria: Team can define experiments via Console or YAML with exposure schedule, stopping rules, and metric objectives
Exposure Governor enforces per-cohort exposure caps and prevents growth if statistical checks fail
Automatic rollback triggers when primary safety metric crosses configured threshold (and appears in Console audit log)
Hypothesis Scheduler runs sequential A/B checks (e.g., alpha-spending) and reports p-values, confidence intervals, and FDR-adjusted decisions
Shadow traffic mode available with cost estimate and no user-visible routing until explicitly promoted
End-to-end internal beta run completed with two product teams and documented learnings
comments: 2025-01-16 - Kickoff: Met with Eng (Marco, Sanya) and Design (Aisha). Agreed MVP should cover: per-variant exposure cap, time-windowed sequential tests, and a human-in-loop rollback button. Recorded initial metrics set: latency P95, token cost per request, and user-level quality signal (regression rate).

2025-01-21 - Design review: Aisha shared Console mockups (Confluence link below). PM feedback: require a compact ‘experiment timeline’ view showing exposure ramp, check outcomes, and active safety gates. Design proposes an explicit ‘risk budget’ meter.

2025-01-27 - Eng scoping: Marco flagged two engineering trade-offs: (1) running statistical checks centrally vs pushing to downstream analytics (latency vs telemetry fidelity), (2) storing per-request metadata for cohort attribution increases storage and cost. Decision: MVP will use event-stream-based checks with sample joins for final verdicts; full streaming sequential testing deferred.
2025-02-05 - Security/Compliance: Security asked for audit fields (operator, timestamp, reason) on auto-rollback actions. Added requirement to acceptance criteria.

2025-02-12 - Cross-functional demo: Implemented a prototype YAML experiment spec and local scheduler that simulated ramp scenarios. Demo logs showed correct early-stop behavior under injected regressions. Feedback: make thresholds more conservative and add two-step abort confirmation for auto-rollbacks that affect >10% exposure.

2025-02-18 - Stakeholder alignment: Presented governance model to Growth and Enterprise SEs. They requested an API to pin traffic to dedicated pools for enterprise experiments. Added as follow-up (dependency to ENG-9123).
notes: Design decision: Use sequential testing (alpha-spending) for primary metrics and control FDR across secondary metrics via Benjamini-Hochberg to limit false positives during exploratory experiments.
Rollout policy: default max exposure 5% for 48 hours, then 25% for 24 hours if checks pass, then 100% after manual approval (configurable per experiment).

Safety heuristic: if latency P95 increases by >30% and user-quality regressions >1.5x baseline, trigger soft-rollback (route new traffic away) and notify on-call. Hard rollback only if both signals persist for 3 consecutive windows.
Operational consideration: Shadow traffic path must be cost-tagged and excluded from billing analytics unless explicitly enabled. Provide cost estimate in Console before enabling shadow mode.
Telemetry: requires new request tagging (experiment_id, cohort, input_hash) — ENG work item tracked separately.
Open question: whether to allow hierarchical experiments (feature + model variant) — postpone to future iteration to avoid combinatorial cohort explosion.
implementation_plan: M2 - Core scheduler + YAML/API for experiment definitions (in progress)
M3 - Server-side gating and sequential testing infra (depends on ENG-8421)
M4 - Auto-rollback integration with routing and audit logs
M5 - Internal beta with Growth and Messaging teams, capture metrics and playbook
risks: Underpowered experiments leading to noisy decisions — mitigate with minimum sample-size enforcement and conservative default ramps
Increased telemetry costs if full request-level logging is enabled — mitigate via sampling and post-join checks
Accidental promotion of faulty variants due to metric mis-specification — mitigate with required review + safety thresholds for initial exposure >5%
next_steps: Finalize YAML schema and Console create flow (owner: Design/PM)
ENG to prototype sequential testing library and a small-scale scheduler (owner: Marco)
Schedule internal beta kickoff with Growth (target start 2025-03-17)
Add audit fields to rollback events per security request
